job.job_title: Junior AI Engineer - GenAI & Data Engineering (GCP/AWS/Databricks/Snow
job.job_description:
Position: Junior AI Engineer - GenAI & Data Engineering (GCP/AWS/Databricks/Snowflake)

Experience: 2 to 5 years

Location: Hyderabad

Employment Type: Full-Time




Roles & Responsibilities



Develop and deploy Generative AI solutions using LLMs and modern AI frameworks.
Build, test, and optimize AI/ML models for business use cases.
Design and implement data pipelines to prepare, transform, and process large datasets.
Work with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, Databricks, or Snowflake to support AI workloads.
Develop and maintain RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) applications and AI-powered assistants.
Create prompts, workflows, and integrations for Generative AI applications.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and business teams to gather requirements and deliver AI solutions.
Support model deployment, monitoring, and performance optimization activities.
Utilize Python, SQL, and cloud-native tools for data processing and model development.
Ensure data quality, security, and governance standards are followed across AI and data engineering workflows.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to AI models, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure.
Stay updated with emerging technologies in Generative AI, LLMs, data engineering, and cloud platforms.
job.ai_reason: Strong production RAG experience, LangGraph workflows, FastAPI backend, AWS deployments, and transferable cloud skills.
